foyer.name: Dusty Foyer
foyer.description: A grand entrance with a sweeping staircase. A heavy oak door leads north, and a cold breeze blows from the west.

hall.name: Grand Hall
hall.description: A long hallway lined with portraits whose eyes seem to follow you. The air is thick with the smell of old parchment.

library.name: Forgotten Library
library.description: Thousands of books rot on the shelves. A single candle flickers on a desk.

bedroom.name: Master Bedroom
bedroom.description: A decayed four-poster bed dominates the room. A ghostly figure hovers near the window, weeping.

silver_key.name: Silver Key
silver_key.description: An ornate key that feels ice-cold to the touch.

ancient_tome.name: Ancient Tome
ancient_tome.description: A book of rituals. One page describes how to appease a grieving spirit.

locket.name: Golden Locket
locket.description: A small locket containing a faded photograph of a family.

interactions.message: You read the tome. You learn that giving a lost loved one's memento to a ghost can bring them peace.
You hold out the locket. The ghost stops weeping, takes the locket with a spectral touch, and vanishes with a sigh of relief. The room feels warmer.
The ghost shrieks and pushes you back! You don't know how to use this item properly.
With the ghost gone, the silver key finally turns in the lock of the front door. You step out into the moonlight. YOU ESCAPED THE MANOR!
The key turns, but an invisible force slams the door shut. Something in this house is still unhappy.
